---
title: "Sprott I System"
---

## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& -y\\
\dot{y} &=& x+az\\
\dot{z} &=& x+y^2-z
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=0.84$ and initial condition $(-8,2,4)$.
